 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. A member of the attacking ranks at La Liga giants Real Madrid has this week been linked with what would come as an altogether surprising move to Brazil, with Santos.
 The Blancos star in question? Rodrygo.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Frontman Rodrygo is of course sidelined long-term at present, owing to an ACL injury suffered all the way back in March.
 The 25-year-old has spent recent weeks steadily ramping up his recovery efforts, though, amid hopes of a return to the pitch early in the new year.
 And as alluded to above, keen to snatch Rodrygo away from Spain's capital upon the versatile attacker being medically cleared are none other than his former employers at Santos.
 As per a report from Goal , citing Diario Sport:
 'The Brazilian club have made initial, informal contact with Real Madrid about taking winger Rodrygo Goes on loan during the first half of 2027.'
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Any such transfer would see Rodrygo reunited with former international teammates Neymar Jr. and Philippe Coutinho.
 It is also noted, however, that Real Madrid have absolutely zero intention of sanctioning Rodrygo's exit, either on loan or a permanent basis.
 Conor Laird – GSFN
